author: vladthegreat100
body:
Not sure if this is the place to be, but as I remember, screamer links are bannable, and so said a SrMod (Who's Name will not be said unless necessary). He sent to Venomous and I a screamer link, we reported it to the Senior Mod who was there, not sure if he looked at my picture but here is what the Senior Mod said.
He said that screamers are bannable. But then HitByADagger had said that someone gave it to him and he just copied the link and pasted it to someone else, and he also said at that same time that it's not fair that someone sends him a screamer link and he doesn't get banned but the Sr Mod originally was going to ban him. After that the Senior Mod decided to say he will leave HitByADagger with a warning.
Which comes in. Did he REALLY look at this picture (http://i.imgur.com/4618Mpq.png) that was sent on the 24th of April?
I understand that he wouldn't be banned after saying that he only copied and pasted it from someone else who sent it to him. But if you look at my picture he clearly states that "this song is good http://akk.li/pics/anne.jpg" (DO NOT TOUCH THE LINK...)
So you mind looking into that, maybe banning him from teamspeak?
Not a big fan of some guy I just meet decide to send a screamer link and said it's a good song. I'm sure you guys don't like it either.
Please Note that I was 1v1ing on Kareoke Party in the Music room, hence he sent the link to try to troll me hoping I don't know what the link is.

Thanks for reading this! :)
